deltas.rationale: L2 / SC7-002: GPLv3 ↮ Apache-2.0 + Mac App Store. Cannot link GPLv3 espeak-ng into a binary distributed under Apache-2.0 license; Mac App Store also rejects GPL apps. Reverses the current primary/fallback assignment.
deltas.blocks_freeze_if_unapproved: yes for Mac App Store path, no for hackathon DMG (the DMG could ship with espeak-ng if user explicitly accepts Apache-2.0 + GPLv3 incompatibility for hackathon-scope only — but recommended NO regardless)

deltas.current_value: thinking mode + 256K + function-call 3가지 load-bearing임을 SPEC.md architecture diagram에 명시. 각 feature 제거 시 product 성립 안 함을 ablation table로 입증.
deltas.proposed_value: thinking mode + 256K-context CAPABILITY + function-call 3가지 load-bearing임을 SPEC.md architecture diagram에 명시. 256K context는 multi-year wondering log COMPRESSED-RECALL 능력 (직접 주입이 아닌 surface_past_wonder를 통한 선택적 호출). 라이브 컨텍스트 윈도우 ≤ 32K 토큰, KV cache INT8 minimum, peak RAM ≤ 7 GB on 16 GB Mac. 각 feature 제거 시 product 성립 안 함을 ablation table로 입증.
deltas.rationale: L3 / SC6-03: literal 256K live KV cache is RAM-infeasible on consumer M-series (~12.5 GB working set). Reframing to compressed-recall preserves the architectural promise without misrepresenting the runtime.
deltas.blocks_freeze_if_unapproved: spec freezes either way, but demo-day claim must match. If user objects, alternative is to demand a hardware tier with much higher RAM (e.g. 64 GB Mac Studio) for the 'multi-year direct injection' framing — practically impossible for hackathon.

deltas.proposed_value: viseme-audio drift: ≤ 30ms RMS within segment, ≤ 80ms peak; inter-segment gap ≤ 150ms tolerated for code-switched output (deliberate pause)
deltas.rationale: L7 / SC6-04 + SOURCE.md: beard-occlusion makes drift more perceptible, not less. ATSC IS-191 broadcast tolerance ≤ 45 ms lag; SMPTE ≤ 22 ms; closeup viewing ≤ 40 ms perception threshold.
deltas.owner_authority: spec-lead (perf target tightening; demo-day rehearsal must hit it but does not affect product semantics)

deltas.current_value: STT accuracy on Korean+English mixed: ≥ 90% word accuracy (Speech framework baseline)
deltas.proposed_value: STT accuracy: primary-language word accuracy ≥ 90% (Speech framework baseline, ko-KR or en-US single-locale recognizer per utterance); code-switched foreign tokens MAY be transliterated and are not penalized; user can manually toggle locale before each utterance for explicit code-switching scenes
deltas.rationale: L12 / SC4-003: SFSpeechRecognizer is single-locale; native multilingual mode does not exist. The original metric is unfalsifiable.

SC6-07: 16 ms (1 frame at 60 Hz display) crossfade is ~0 GPU cost and hides the hard-cut discontinuity that the painterly bust style otherwise emphasizes. Reduces perception of drift on the only-mouth-visible region (per SOURCE.md beard occlusion).
deltas.note: If user prefers original hard-cut feel, this delta can be reverted with no engineering impact.
